name: ufo-mcp-extension
description: Control Dynatrace UFO lighting devices with shared state across multiple Claude Desktop instances. Enables multi-agent coordination through a centralized HTTP MCP server.

ufo_mcp_server.title: UFO MCP Server URL
ufo_mcp_server.description: URL of the UFO MCP HTTP server

tools.name: configureLighting
tools.description: Configure UFO lighting patterns with rings, brightness, logo and effects

tools.name: playEffect
tools.description: Play predefined lighting effects like rainbow, police lights, etc.

tools.name: stopEffect
tools.description: Stop current effect and resume previous state from effect stack

tools.name: getLedState
tools.description: Get current LED state showing all colors, brightness and running effect

tools.name: sendRawApi
tools.description: Send raw API commands directly to UFO hardware
